d0296ceed8a10b17.description: As a Data Management Consultant , you will play a key role in designing, implementing, and optimizing data governance, data quality, and metadata management frameworks. You will work closely with clients and internal teams to assess current data maturity, align data practices with organizational goals, and ensure compliance with national and international standards (e.g., NDMO, DAMA-DMBOK, ISO 8000). ey Responsibilities: Assess the current state of data management processes, tools, and governance structures. Design and implement data governance frameworks and policies. Define data standards, business glossaries, and metadata frameworks. Support the development of data catalogs and data lineage documentation. Collaborate with IT, business stakeholders, and compliance teams to enforce data quality and governance. Lead data maturity assessments and gap analysis reports. Provide expertise in master data management (MDM) and reference data frameworks. Develop training materials and deliver workshops to build internal data management capabilities. Align data practices with regulatory standards such as PDPL, GDPR, NDMO, or industry-specific regulations. Monitor compliance with data governance and data stewardship roles. Qualifications: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in data science, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in data governance, data architecture, or data quality management. Solid understanding of data management frameworks (DAMA-DMBOK, DCAM). Experience with data governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Informatica, Alation, Talend). Knowledge of metadata management and data cataloging tools. Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP) and modern data architecture (e.g., Data Mesh, Data Lakehouse). Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams. Preferred Certifications: CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional) by DAMA DGSP (Data Governance and Stewardship Professional) TOGAF (for data architecture alignment) PMP (Project Management Professional) or equivalent Key Competencies: Strategic thinking and data-driven mindset Strong business and technical acumen Attention to detail and regulatory compliance Change management and stakeholder engagement Workshop facilitation and training delivery

d0312debd85eea94.description: The Medical Readiness & Training Manager is responsible for building and sustaining a city-wide culture of emergency preparedness at Qiddiya. The role owns the full cycle of first aid and first responder training, certification compliance, emergency drill planning and evaluation, and event medical readiness. Working within healthcare operations, the Manager ensures that Qiddiya’s workforce is continuously trained, certified, and operationally ready to respond to medical emergencies across all venues and activations. Key Responsibilities First Aid & First Responder Training Design, deliver, and continuously improve first aid and first responder training programs aligned with AHA/SHA Heartsaver standards and applicable national requirements. Develop and maintain training materials including manuals, skill-station scenarios, simulation scripts, and competency assessment tools. Supervise and mentor first aid instructors, ensuring consistent delivery quality and standardized assessment across all training cohorts. Maintain city-wide certification compliance, ensuring all designated staff hold valid AHA/SHA or equivalent credentials at all times, with proactive renewal tracking. Coordinate with City Operations, HR, and department heads to embed certification requirements into onboarding and role-specific duty conditions. Produce monthly certification compliance dashboards and escalate gaps to the Executive Director, Healthcare Operations. 2.2 Emergency Drills, Simulations & Performance Reporting Design and manage annual drill and simulation calendar covering mass casualty incidents, medical emergencies, mass gathering scenarios, and venue-specific response exercises. Facilitate tabletop exercises and live simulations, coordinating participants across City Operations, and external partners as required. Evaluate drill performance using standardized checklists, response time metrics, and team-performance criteria; produce structured after-action reports with corrective recommendations. Track corrective action closure and retest through follow-up drills to confirm sustained improvement in response performance. 2.3 Public Health Awareness & Community Outreach Plan and deliver an annual public health awareness calendar aligned with national health observances and Qiddiya’s operational calendar, covering priority topics such as heat illness prevention, cardiac health, diabetes awareness, and mass gathering safety. Coordinate with Marketing & Communications to produce guest and staff-facing health education content, including signage, digital materials, and event-based messaging. Build and maintain relationships with partner hospitals, referral facilities, and community health stakeholders to support integrated health promotion and care pathways for Qiddiya’s workforce and guests. Measure outreach reach and engagement and report outcomes to the Executive Director, Healthcare Operations. 2.4 Vaccination Programs Plan and supervise staff vaccination drives in coordination with the healthcare provider and Ministry of Health requirements, covering seasonal influenza, meningitis, and other mandated or recommended programs. • Track vaccination coverage rates against defined targets, maintain records, and produce reports for leadership and regulatory submission. Coordinate logistics for vaccination campaigns including scheduling, venue setup, cold chain compliance, and post-campaign adverse event monitoring. 2.5 Volunteer Management Recruit, train, and coordinate a pool of volunteer first aiders drawn from across Qiddiya’s workforce, maintaining their certification status and deploying them to supplement professional medical coverage at events and activations. Develop and manage a roster of volunteer first aid instructors to support scaling of training delivery across the city, ensuring instructor quality through observation, feedback, and standardization. Recruit and train Standardized Patients (SPs) to support realistic simulation exercises and emergency drills, managing their briefing, role preparation, and performance feedback to ensure high-fidelity scenario delivery. Maintain complete volunteer records including profiles, training history, certification status, deployment logs, and performance feedback; recognize and retain high-performing volunteers to build program continuity. 2.6 AED Network & First Responder Readiness Oversee the city-wide AED placement strategy, maintaining an up-to-date inventory of all devices, inspection schedules, and readiness status across all Qiddiya venues. Build and maintain a layered first responder network across city departments, ensuring adequate coverage of trained lay responders at all operational areas and venues. Promote the Qiddiya Life Saver program to grow bystander first aid capability among staff, embedding a culture of emergency preparedness across the city workforce. 2.7 Event & Venue Medical Readiness Conduct pre-event medical readiness assessments for major activations, theme park openings, and mass gathering events, verifying that staffing, equipment, and trained responders meet defined standards. Develop venue-specific emergency response plans and coordinate readiness briefings with operational teams ahead of activations and high-footfall periods. 2.8 Reporting & Continuous Improvement Prepare and present monthly readiness reports to the Executive Director, Healthcare Operations, covering training throughput, certification status, drill outcomes, and AED network status. Identify and implement evidence-based improvements to training, drill design, and readiness programs through data analysis, after-action review, and benchmarking against mass gathering and entertainment industry standards. 2.9 Regulatory Compliance & Governance Ensure all training programs, certifications, and readiness activities comply with Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS), Ministry of Health, and Qiddiya governance requirements. Maintain accurate records of all training, drills, certifications, and readiness assessments to support audit, accreditation, and regulatory inspection readiness. Support CMS governance by contributing readiness data and insights to the broader healthcare operations reporting cycle. • Bachelor’s degree in Emergency Medical Services, Paramedicine, Nursing, Public Health, or a related clinical discipline. • Valid SCFHS professional license in a relevant clinical category. • Minimum 5–7 years of experience in emergency medical services, healthcare training, or mass gathering medicine, with at least 2–3 years in a training, education, or emergency preparedness role.

d00a8197016df6b0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة قمة الرياحين للمقاولات عن فني أجهزة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جازان. يركز هذا الدور على تركيب وصيانة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، بالإضافة إلى دعم مهندسي الإلكترونيات في أنشطة البحث والتطوير. هذه فرصة بدوام كامل تتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب ومراقبة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، بما في ذلك الدوائر وعناصر التحكم والآلات. دراسة المخططات لتحديد نوع وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والميكانيكيين والحرفيين الآخرين في عمليات تركيب الأجهزة الإلكترونية. اختبار الأجهزة الإلكترونية بعد التركيب لضمان مطابقتها للمخططات والمواصفات. إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية للصيانة الوقائية وتشخيص التلفيات والأعطال المحتملة، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية. تقديم المساعدة التقنية لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في جهود البحث والتطوير المتعلقة بالأجهزة الإلكترونية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال إصلاح الأنظمة الإلكترونية. خبرة متخصصة في الدوائر التلفزيونية المغلقة (CCTV) ونظم الإنذار الإلكترونية الأخرى، بما في ذلك نظم التحكم في الدخول وإنذار الحريق. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات والدوائر الإلكترونية. مهارة عالية في اكتشاف الأعطال وإصلاحها. القدرة على تنفيذ الصيانة الوقائية لأنظمة الأمن الإلكتروني. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الأجهزة الإلكترونية ضمن فريق متخصص في جازان، ويؤدي مهامه بدوام كامل. يتطلب الدور التعاون مع مهندسي الإلكترونيات والعمال الآخرين لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. التقديم لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذا الدور. على المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه، يرجى تقديم طلباتهم.

d0e8507f005e021a.job_title: Parts Man Al Futtaim Automotive BYD
d0e8507f005e021a.description: About the Role Al Futtaim Group is seeking a Parts Man to manage the physical handling, storage, picking, packing, and dispatch of genuine automotive parts within the dealership warehouse. This full-time role is crucial for maintaining inventory accuracy, supporting workshop efficiency, and ensuring timely parts availability for service operations, retail customers, and inter-branch requirements. The position requires 0-1 years of experience. Role Purpose and Impact The Parts Man directly contributes to workshop productivity, customer satisfaction, and overall aftersales performance by managing warehouse discipline, safe handling practices, and accurate stock movement. This role requires a highly disciplined, accurate, and physically active team member to maintain warehouse standards and ensure the safe handling of high-value, fragile, and high-voltage (HV) components. Key Responsibilities Receive incoming parts shipments and verify quantities, part numbers, and condition against purchase orders and delivery notes. Identify and report discrepancies, shortages, damaged goods, or incorrect deliveries to the Parts Supervisor immediately. Bin parts accurately into designated storage locations using FIFO principles and OEM storage requirements. Ensure proper storage conditions for fragile parts, fluids, batteries, tyres, lubricants, and hazardous materials in accordance with safety standards. Handle high-voltage (HV) battery components and sensitive parts using approved safety procedures and protective equipment. Pick parts accurately for workshop Repair Orders, retail customer sales, body shop requirements, and inter-branch transfers using issued pick lists. Verify picked quantities and part numbers before dispatch to minimize workshop delays and customer complaints. Package parts securely for transportation, ensuring special care for fragile, oversized, or high-value items. Dispatch parts to internal departments, external customers, and branch locations on time while maintaining delivery documentation and proof of dispatch. Support urgent workshop requirements to minimize vehicle downtime and service delays. Inventory and Warehouse Management Conduct daily cycle counts and support scheduled stock takes to maintain high inventory accuracy and traceability. Monitor stock condition and report damaged, expired, obsolete, or slow-moving inventory to the Parts Supervisor for corrective action. Ensure correct stock rotation and minimize stock losses, shrinkage, and binning errors. Maintain proper labeling, bin location accuracy, and warehouse organization across all storage areas. Maintain warehouse cleanliness, organization, and 5S standards across all aisles, shelves, and storage locations. Safety and Compliance Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, trolleys, and warehouse handling equipment safely and within certification guidelines. Follow all HSE procedures including safe lifting, PPE usage, chemical handling, and hazardous goods protocols. Ensure compliance with OEM standards, customs regulations, audit requirements, and internal controls related to parts traceability and inventory management. Experience Required Candidates should possess 0-1 years of relevant experience in parts handling or warehouse operations.

d0e2d74d758c8a50.job_title: Sap Tax Technology Specialist - Sap, Monitoring, Zakat
d0e2d74d758c8a50.description: Job description About the job SAP TAX TECHNOLOGY SPECIALIST - SAP, MONITORING, ZAKAT Purpose: Configure SAR's ERP and build the monitoring toolkit so zakat, VAT and WHT data is captured, calculated, reported and flagged automatically. Key responsibilities Assess the current ERP set-up for tax codes, GL mapping and master data, and close the gaps for zakat, VAT and WHT. Build or configure zakat base tracking, calculation and reporting inside the ERP. Embed tax checks in daily posting and the monthly close so data stays accurate continuously. Build the VAT/WHT validation and monitoring model: return-to-GL reconciliation, sample tests, exception logs. Configure alerts that notify management of discrepancies and unusual patterns (e.g. rate mismatches, missing WHT on foreign payments, spikes vs prior months). Design exportable, audit-ready reports in formats ZATCA and external auditors accept. Document the solution and train finance users; hand over to SAR's IT and tax teams. Deliverables ERP tax configuration design and change log VAT/WHT validation and monitoring toolkit (model, dashboards, alert rules) Zakat calculation and reporting module Report pack and user guide Experience Required Bachelor's in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems or similar 6+ years in ERP finance (SAP FI/CO, S/4HANA or Oracle Fusion Financials), including at least one tax configuration project Hands-on with KSA VAT, WHT and ZATCA e-invoicing (FATOORA) integration Data and reporting skills: SQL, Power BI or SAP Analytics Cloud, advanced Excel Preferred: SAP/Oracle certification, Big 4 or tax-technology consulting background, Arabic Division: Technology Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

Represent the technical position in steering and status meetings, and explain design trade-offs and risks to technical and non-technical audiences. Good understanding of migration methods and tooling and of landing zone concepts Understanding of Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD practices, enough to review how delivery teams apply them. d09460eeda2c17dc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة البسفور للفنادق عن مدير جودة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية المشاركة في وضع أهداف وسياسات الجودة والإشراف المباشر على أنشطة إدارة الجودة، بما يضمن توافقها مع الخطط التشغيلية وتحقيق أقصى قدر من الكفاءة والفعالية في العمليات اليومية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في صياغة الأهداف والمبادرات والخطط التشغيلية لضمان معايير جودة وكفاءة عالية في الجهة والوحدات التابعة لها. متابعة تنفيذ الخطط الموضوعة والتأكد من وجود أطر ومقاييس دقيقة لتقييم مستوى تحقيق الأهداف. تطوير الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التفصيلية التي تهدف إلى رفع جودة المخرجات والخدمات، ووضع الأطر والمقاييس لضمان استمراريتها ومتابعة تنفيذها. مراجعة وتطوير أنظمة ومعايير وإجراءات ونماذج ضبط وتوكيد الجودة، والإشراف على نشرها وتعميمها ومتابعة تطبيقها من خلال عمليات التدقيق. متابعة أحدث التطورات والممارسات في أنظمة الجودة ووسائل توكيد المطابقة، وتقديم مقترحات لتحديث أنظمة الجودة والتدقيق المعتمدة. الإشراف على إعداد التقارير والملخصات المتعلقة بأعمال توكيد ومعايير الجودة، وعرضها على الإدارة العليا، وإحاطتها بالتحديات والمستجدات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة بإدارة الجودة. القدرة على المساهمة في وضع الأهداف والسياسات والخطط التشغيلية. فهم جيد لمبادئ ومعايير ضبط وتوكيد الجودة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تخطيط وتنظيم ممتازة. القدرة على متابعة تنفيذ الخطط وتقييم الأداء. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتطوير الأنظمة والإجراءات. مهارات تواصل فعالة لتقديم التقارير والتوصيات. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

d0ce7ff335a7f553.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة عن كاتب موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم الإداري والتشغيلي الشامل لإدارة الموارد البشرية، ويشمل ذلك مجالات الاستقطاب، والتهيئة، والمزايا، وعلاقات الموظفين، والسجلات، والرواتب، والتدريب، بالإضافة إلى ضمان الالتزام بالسياسات والأنظمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دعم عملية الإعلان عن الوظائف، وفرز طلبات التوظيف، والتنسيق للمقابلات، وإجراءات تهيئة الموظفين الجدد. تحديث وحفظ بيانات الموظفين، والمعلومات الوظيفية، وتقييمات الأداء بشكل دقيق ومنظم. تجميع ومراجعة سجلات الحضور، وساعات العمل الإضافي، والإجازات لدعم عمليات إعداد الرواتب. تنظيم برامج التدريب، وتوثيق الشهادات، وتحديد الاحتياجات التطويرية للموظفين. الرد على استفسارات الموظفين المتعلقة بالسياسات الداخلية، والمزايا، والإجراءات المتبعة في الشركة. دعم الالتزام بنظام العمل، وتحديث الوثائق والتقارير ذات الصلة. تقديم الدعم الإداري العام، بما في ذلك جدولة الاجتماعات وإعداد المراسلات الرسمية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الموارد البشرية أو دور إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المهام الإدارية المتعددة بكفاءة. مهارات تنظيمية وتواصل ممتازة. نوع العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة دوام كامل. الموقع يقع مقر العمل في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

d0e892469f54403e.description: About the Role Alesayi Holding is seeking an Estate Coordinator to manage the daily operations of labor accommodation buildings in the Eastern region of Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing both outsourced and in-house facilities, ensuring compliance, maintaining standards, and addressing resident needs. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The Estate Coordinator is responsible for the day-to-day control and oversight of a portfolio of labor accommodation buildings. This includes ensuring provider compliance, conducting regular inspections, managing maintenance activities, and resolving resident issues to maintain high living standards and operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities Monitor outsourced accommodation providers to ensure adherence to contract terms, service levels, and billing accuracy; validate invoices and escalate any deviations. Conduct regular inspections of accommodation buildings, assessing cleanliness, hygiene, maintenance condition, and overall living standards, documenting findings and ensuring follow-up to resolution. Ensure resident well-being and safety, including compliance with fire-safety regulations; serve as the primary contact for resident complaints and facilitate their resolution within agreed timelines. Log, prioritize, and follow up on maintenance requests with external providers or in-house technicians, tracking recurring faults and cost per building. Maintain comprehensive accommodation records, including occupancy data, licenses, permits, and inspection reports, ensuring they are audit-ready and compliant with government inspection requirements. Produce a monthly estate scorecard detailing occupancy rates, cost per head, service-level performance, open complaints, and safety findings. Experience Required Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in a similar role, preferably within facilities management or accommodation coordination. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Eastern region of Saudi Arabia, involving direct oversight of accommodation facilities and interaction with residents and service providers. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this position at Alesayi Holding. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

d0104ccb884b1467.description: About the Role Modern Mills For Food Products Co. is seeking a Boiler Operator to join their team in Khamis Mushayt. This full-time role is critical for ensuring the safe, efficient, and reliable operation of the boiler and steam generation system, providing a continuous supply of steam essential for feed production processes. Role Purpose The Boiler Operator supports uninterrupted manufacturing operations by maintaining optimal boiler performance. This involves conducting routine inspections, monitoring water treatment systems, and ensuring compliance with health, safety, environmental, food safety, and quality standards, while also maximizing equipment reliability and energy efficiency. Key Responsibilities Operate, monitor, and control the boiler system to ensure a continuous and reliable steam supply for feed production. Start up, shut down, and adjust boiler operations according to production schedules and standard operating procedures. Monitor boiler pressure, temperature, water level, fuel consumption, and steam output to maintain optimal operating conditions. Supply steam to pellet mills and other production equipment while ensuring stable pressure and temperature. Monitor and maintain boiler water treatment systems to ensure proper water quality and prevent scaling, corrosion, and equipment damage. Conduct routine inspections of boilers, burners, pumps, valves, piping, steam traps, and safety devices. Perform daily operational checks and record equipment readings, operating parameters, water treatment results, and maintenance activities. Identify equipment abnormalities and report faults promptly to minimize downtime. Assist the Maintenance team during preventive maintenance, planned shutdowns, and equipment repairs. Respond quickly and safely to boiler alarms, operational failures, and emergency situations. Maintain cleanliness and housekeeping standards within the boiler house and utility areas. Ensure compliance with company Health, Safety, Environmental, Food Safety, and Quality Management System requirements. Coordinate with Production, Maintenance, and Quality teams to ensure uninterrupted utility services. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance boiler efficiency, reduce energy consumption, and improve equipment reliability. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Khamis Mushayt, focusing on maintaining essential utility services within a manufacturing environment.

d05fc503016e3ad5.company_name: Ma'aden - Saudi Arabian Mining Company | معادن
d05fc503016e3ad5.description: About Ma'aden Ma'aden, established in 1997, is recognized as one of the fastest-growing mining companies globally and the largest multi-commodity mining and metals company in the Middle East. The company is instrumental in developing the mining industry to become a key pillar of Saudi Arabia’s economy by building an integrated mining value chain. This full-time role is based in Riyadh. Role Overview The Lead Specialist, Engineering and Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) Enterprise, is responsible for enabling reliable and accessible data across the organization. This involves building and optimizing scalable data pipelines to transform raw data into high-quality information assets. The role ensures data products meet strong governance, operational resilience, and performance standards to support business intelligence, analytics, and decision-making. The position also provides technical leadership to enhance engineering consistency, operational reliability, and long-term platform sustainability. Key Responsibilities Deliver scalable ETL/ELT pipelines that provide reliable, governed, and high-quality data for analytics and reporting. Enable efficient ingestion, transformation, and delivery of data products aligned with approved data models and architecture standards. Maintain engineering practices to ensure consistency, reusability, and long-term maintainability of data solutions. Strengthen trust in enterprise data through robust validation, reconciliation, testing, and quality control mechanisms. Ensure metadata, lineage, and discoverability requirements are embedded across all data assets and pipelines. Enable governed access to curated datasets that support enterprise-wide data consumption. Optimize pipeline efficiency, scalability, and operational performance through continuous tuning and workload optimization. Improve production stability through monitoring, alerting, incident management, and proactive risk mitigation. Reduce operational disruptions by enhancing reliability, restartability, and recovery capabilities. Provide technical guidance that enhances engineering quality, consistency, and delivery excellence. Develop reusable components, standards, and engineering playbooks that improve productivity and reduce complexity. Influence technical decisions that strengthen enterprise data engineering capabilities. Partner with data modelers, governance teams, platform specialists, and business stakeholders to deliver integrated data solutions. Ensure engineering outputs align with enterprise data definitions, governance requirements, and business needs. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance cost efficiency, operability, and solution effectiveness. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in engineering and ETL enterprise functions. The role requires a professional who can embed engineering excellence, data quality controls, and platform standards into data delivery processes. Indicators of Success Enterprise data pipelines consistently deliver trusted, accurate, and timely data products. Data quality issues are identified proactively and resolved efficiently with clear ownership and accountability. Pipeline performance and operational costs are continuously optimized without compromising reliability. Data assets are discoverable, governed, and supported by accurate metadata and lineage. Production incidents are reduced through strong engineering practices, monitoring, and operational excellence. Engineering standards and reusable assets improve delivery speed, quality, and scalability across initiatives. Developing the future operating model for projects and leading pre-opening plans following design reviews and adaptations to meet hotel industry standards. · Preparing and presenting periodic executive reports to senior management covering operational readiness indicators, risk management, and progress milestones. · Leading continuous improvement and development initiatives post-opening to enhance hotel and real estate operational efficiency, maximizing investment returns and asset market value Minimum requirements of role: · Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Minimum of 10 years of professional experience within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. · Practical experience in establishing and governing owners' associations, managing contracts, and internal bylaws under the "Mullak" system issued by the Real Estate General Authority (REGA) is preferred. · Excellent professional proficiency in spoken and written Arabic and English, with fluency in additional languages considered an advantage. · Strong leadership skills and an active field presence to communicate effectively with owners, senior executives, and key stakeholders. · Comprehensive knowledge of regulations and compliance requirements issued by government and regulatory entities (including the Ministry of Municipalities and Housing, Civil Defense, REGA, and relevant hospitality and tourism authorities), with proven capability in license management, operational safety compliance, and professional liaison with owners, consultants, and contractors. · Advanced proficiency in developing scopes of work, contract negotiation, managing operation and maintenance agreements, and evaluating vendor/contractor performance. · Hands-on experience in managing and upgrading large-scale real maintainability, and economic viability. · Thorough understanding of organizational structure design, staffing needs assessment, and the development and implementation of operational policies and We are committed to supporting your career path by granting you the necessary authority and space for leadership innovation, alongside offering a competitive compensation package and salary tailored to your expertise to ensure your growth and continuity with us.

d0363a56efb9745d.description: X-PHY is an industry leader in cybersecurity technology, delivering cutting-edge solutions that proactively protect businesses from evolving cyber threats. We don’t just build products—we build the future. As a cybersecurity technology company, we are redefining industry standards, pushing boundaries, and creating transformative solutions to protect the digital world. Joining us isn’t just about securing a job—it’s about embarking on an entrepreneurial journey. Here, you don’t just work for the company; you grow with it. We seek visionaries who think beyond the ordinary, strategists who challenge the status quo, and action-takers who execute with intensity and precision. If you're ready to shape the future of cybersecurity, we want you on our team. About the Opportunity We are seeking a highly energetic, ambitious, and driven Channel BDM (Business Development Manager - the role responsible for driving market growth and partner acquisition) to aggressively expand market presence across the Middle East for our cutting-edge cybersecurity hardware solutions. This role is designed for a professional with a relentless "hunter" mentality, a willingness to learn quickly, and the stamina to run across the market to close deals. This is not a role for managing the status quo; it requires establishing a robust partner ecosystem from the ground up and mastering the art of solution selling to position advanced cybersecurity hardware as a critical business enabler. Key Responsibilities Market Expansion & Partner Acquisition Targeted Regional Expansion: Spearhead aggressive market entry by executing a localized channel partner strategy. The primary focus will be on penetrating the UAE (United Arab Emirates - a primary business hub country in the Middle East) and KSA (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia - a major, high-growth market country in the Middle East). Lighthouse Account Strategy: Hunt and secure high-profile "lighthouse" accounts (key, early-adopter clients that serve as a beacon to attract other regional customers) within these target countries. This involves working closely with top-tier SI (System Integrator - a business that builds computing systems for clients by combining hardware and software products) partners to establish immediate market credibility and accelerate broader regional adoption. Relentless In-Market Presence: Maintain an aggressive and consistent travel schedule across the target regions. This is a true "boots on the ground" role focused on building face-to-face relationships, knocking on doors, and securing the critical meetings necessary to build a massive sales pipeline. Solution-Led Strategy: Pivot partners away from transactional, feature-based selling. The role requires driving a solution selling strategy that bundles our cybersecurity hardware with partner services to solve specific, complex customer pain points (such as ransomware protection and critical infrastructure defence). Sales & Revenue Generation Target Ownership: Take full ownership of sales targets by directly supporting partners in closing complex, high-value deals using consultative solution selling techniques. Pipeline Management: Work closely with partners to build, track, and accelerate joint business plans, focusing on long-term customer outcomes and recurring value rather than one-off sales. Continuous Learning & Enablement Technical Mastery: Demonstrate a strong willingness to learn the deep technical aspects of hardware-based cybersecurity to confidently educate and empower the partner network on the solution selling methodology. Partner Coaching: Train partner sales teams on how to uncover deep-seated client needs, ask the right discovery questions, and position the hardware as the ultimate business solution in a highly competitive landscape. Candidate Requirements Experience & Mindset Experience: 5 to 8 years of high-performance experience in B2B (Business-to-Business - sales conducted directly between companies rather than to individual consumers) sales, channel development, channel partner management , or account management within the ICT (Information and Communications Technology - the broader technology sector encompassing communications and IT infrastructure) or cybersecurity space. Proactive "Hunter" DNA: A proven track record of relentless prospecting, cold outreach, and breaking into new accounts. The ideal candidate hunts for leads rather than waiting for them. Solution Selling Expertise: Demonstrated ability to transition from product-feature pitching to consultative solution selling , understanding the customer's total journey and underlying business challenges. Coachability: Must be highly adaptable, open to feedback, and eager to master new technologies and sales methodologies. Skills & Competencies High Energy: Possesses the physical and mental stamina to thrive in a fast-paced, high-travel role across the GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council - the regional economic and political union of Arab states bordering the Gulf). Communication: Punchy, confident, and clear presentation skills, with the ability to command a room whether speaking to technical engineers or business owners. Self-Managed, Ownership-Driven Culture that empowers individuals to take initiative and make an impact Performance-Based Bonuses that reward results, contributions, and value creation Passionate, Energetic, and Innovative Work Culture where ideas are encouraged and collaboration thrives Clear Opportunities for Growth and Development through continuous learning, exposure, and career progression Positive and Supportive Work Environment that values respect, teamwork, and high performance
